summary.text: Carrie Isaac is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 73 who has represented the district since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a nonprofit executive.

paragraphs.text: Carrie Isaac was born in Texas, lives in Hays County, and earned a bachelor's degree from Stephen F. Austin State University in 1997.

Her career experience includes working as a nonprofit executive; she has been executive director of the Digital Education & Work Initiative of Texas (DEWIT), public relations coordinator for Helping Hands, and project manager for Sally Johnson Architect LLC.
Isaac took office on January 10, 2023, succeeding Kyle Biedermann.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as Appropriations and Business & Industry.
She advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Merrie Fox in the general election.
